component.name: COSMIC Niri Windows Applet
component.summary: Window list applet for Niri on COSMIC Desktop

description.p: An applet for the COSMIC Desktop panel (cosmic-panel) that displays and manages window lists for the Niri compositor.

ul.li: Monitor Output Filtering: shows per-monitor windows.
Mouse Interactions: Left click to focus, middle click to close, scroll to change workspaces.
